content_html:
Id be interested in seeing a post on your default architecture (if you’re ever short of ideas for blog posts). There is a dearth of information on this topic – what works well? what works ok? what are the tradeoffs?

Most applications I come across are usually awful data access/ business logic/ presentation all mangled together in the same aspx page. I dont think its that the people that are writing them are incaoable of doing better, but that there is little to no guidance on best practices.

I’d love to get more insight into that “stack o books”..

Some of the 10 year old books I have are the *very best* i’ve read (or working through)..

Care to share your favorites?
